Package domain.model

Class Square

java.lang.Object
domain.model.Hidato
domain.model.Square
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Square extends Hidato
Represents a Hidato board with square-shaped cells. This class extends the abstract Hidato class and implements the logic for identifying adjacent cells based on side or side+angle connections.

  • Method Details

    • getAdjacents

      public Collection<int[]> getAdjacents(int r, int c)
      Retrieves a collection of coordinates for cells adjacent to the specified position. For square cells, adjacency is determined by the board's Adjacency type: - C: Only shares a side (up, down, left, right). - CA: Shares a side or a corner (all 8 surrounding cells). * @param r The row index of the cell.
      Specified by:
      getAdjacents in class Hidato
      Parameters:
      r - Row index.
      c - The column index of the cell.
      Returns:
      A Collection of int arrays, where each array contains {row, column} of an adjacent cell.
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the provided coordinates are outside the board dimensions.
